app.name: Picture frame
app.summary: A picture on a tile: a person's photo, an image entity, what plays, or any picture at an address.
app.url_hint: The address of a picture on image.tmdb.org or images.unsplash.com. Leave it empty to show the entity's own picture.
app.fit_hint: Cover fills the tile and cuts away what is over; contain shows the whole picture.
app.caption: Name over the picture
app.caption_hint: The tile's name in the corner of the picture.
